proposition: Dates given for the Mafāḥiṣ vary in kind. The dissertation records the Majlis manuscript as copied in 823/1420 with autograph sections, an audition note of 828/1425, and says it was produced in 817-25/1414-22; Sensorium gives 823-28/1420-25, Grammatology completed 823/1420 and revised 828/1425, the Prologue 1420 in its title and MS 'copied and added to between 1420-25'. The older project docs' 'completes the Mafāḥiṣ in 1420' is the copy date; no paper read says it was written in a single year.

mediation.who: MS Majlis 10196 and Beinecke MS Landberg 146
mediation.note: 823/1420 is a copying date; the dissertation flags the Beinecke date with a query
